
# Player Characters 

# How to Create a Player Character

## 1. Roll Ability scores

Roll 3d6 seven times and drop the lowest total. Assign the scores to your [Character Abilities](abilities.qmd#ability-scores) in any order, or in-order if you're cool. If none of your attributes are 14 or higher, you may swap any of your scores with a 14.

Write down the ability score bonus (or penalty) for each score beside the score itself, as shown on the table on the [Character Abilities](abilities.qmd#ability-scores) page.

## 2. Choose a Race

Choose a race for your character, see the [Character Races](races.qmd#character-races) section.

Write down the special abilities of your race.

## 3. Choose a Class

Choose a character class for your character, see the [Character Classes](class.qmd#character-classes) section.

Write down the special abilities of your class. Choose a starting equipment package for your class.

## 4. Miscellany

* Mark 0 XP and the amount of XP required for 2nd level.

* Roll the hit die appropriate for your class (re-rolling 1s and 2s), add your Constitution modifier, and note the result as your hit point maximum (minimum of 1 hit point).

* Note your armor class (AC), modified by Dexterity.

* Note your attack bonus, modified by Strength for melee weapons and Dexterity for ranged weapons.

* Note your saving throws.

Finally, name your character.
